caseName: Christie v. Natioal Collegiate Athletic Ass'n
caseNameFull: Christopher J. CHRISTIE, Governor of New Jersey v. NATIOAL COLLEGIATE ATHLETIC ASSOCIATION

opinions.text: Motion of Professor Ryan M. Rodenberg for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
